The '''Vindicator''' [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] [[Lightsaber hilt/Legends|hilt]] was occasionally used by the students of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] [[New Jedi Order]]. The Vindicator hilt was created from two identical hilts forged together.
